title: Hello, World
description: The year I started taking programming seriously, building fundamentals in problem-solving and software thinking.

title: Java, Python, and First AI
description: Java was my first primary language, followed by Python. I built my first AI projects and discovered a strong interest in intelligent systems.

title: The Rise of AI & SOPA
description: Marked the beginning of SOPA—my independent, autonomous AI home/smart assistant. Focused on system architecture, intent recognition, and long-running background protocols. Planned as open-source once mature.

title: Tools, Systems, and SOPA-MK4
description: Shifted toward building developer tools and internal frameworks. SOPA-MK4 emphasized modularity, scalability, and cross-platform compatibility. Heavy focus on Linux, automation, and system integration.

title: Cloud, Web, and Reinforcement Learning
description: Expanded into cloud infrastructure and web interfaces to make SOPA accessible anywhere. Deepened work with Reinforcement Learning to move from reactive behavior toward autonomous decision-making.

title: Autonomy, Robotics, and Intelligence at Scale
description: Focused on advanced autonomy: behavior trees, learning-driven decision systems, and robotics integration. Bridging AI, control systems, and real-world interaction.
